story.fullStory:
Helen Reddy's "Angie Baby" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Angie Baby" is a song written by American singer-songwriter Alan O'Day which became a hit for Australian singer Helen Reddy.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Angie Baby was released in 1974.

"Angie Baby" is a song written by American singer-songwriter Alan O'Day which became a hit for Australian singer Helen Reddy.

Wilson of Fine Arts Films made an accompanying animated short film for the song when it appeared on The Midnight Special (broadcast October 31, 1975), as well as on The Sonny & Cher Show in the mid-1970s (Wilson made many other animated shorts for various hit records of the era and his work became a prominent regular feature of the show).
